description: This file defines the implementation of the Mersenne Twister 19937 (mt19937) random number generator engine within the ATen namespace, including constants, data structures, and the engine class with methods for initialization, state management, and number generation. It also contains detailed comments on performance considerations and licensing.

classes.name: mt19937_engine
classes.description: A class implementing the MT19937 engine with methods for seeding, state management, and generating random numbers.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates the next random number in the sequence.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns the current state data of the engine.

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Returns the seed used to initialize the engine.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the engine's current state is valid.

methods.name: init_with_uint32
methods.description: Initializes the engine with a seed value.

methods.name: mix_bits
methods.description: Combines bits from two uint32 values.

methods.name: twist
methods.description: Performs the twist transformation used in the MT19937 algorithm.

methods.name: next_state
methods.description: Generates the next state of the engine.
